name: flight-atlas-mobile
description: Android companion for Flight Atlas (shared frontend, separate Capacitor shell)

scripts.android:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:aab: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
